f.statement: A DHPC should be disseminated when there is a need to take immediate action or change current practice, namely: suspension, withdrawal or revocation of a marketing authorisation for safety reasons; an important change to use due to restriction of indication, new contraindication or dose change for safety reasons; or a restriction in availability or discontinuation with potential detrimental effects on patient care.

rows.quote: Other situations where dissemination of a DHPC should be considered are: • new major warnings or precautions for use in the product information; • new data identifying a previously unknown risk or a change in the frequency or severity of a known risk; • new evidence that the medicinal product is not as effective as previously considered; • new recommendations for preventing or treating adverse reactions or to avoid misuse or medication errors with the medicinal product; • ongoing assessment of an important potential risk, for which data available at a particular point in time are insufficient to take regulatory action (in this case, the DHPC should encourage close monitoring of the safety concern in clinical practice and encourage reporting, and possibly provide information on how to minimise the potential risk).

f.statement: Once the DHPC text is agreed, the MAH should prepare translations in the official languages specified by the Member States where it is to be distributed and submit the draft translations to the Member States for language review (review within a reasonable timeframe not exceeding 4-5 working days).

rows.quote: Once the text of the DHPC is agreed, the marketing authorisation holder should prepare translations in the official languages of the Member States, as specified by the Member States where the DHPC is to be distributed. The draft translations should be submitted to the Member States for a language review and such review should be done within a reasonable timeframe which should not exceed 4-5 working days.
rows.location: XV.C.2.2. Translation and dissemination of DHPCs
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: MAH named; language-review timeframe is the Member States' step, merged.

f.title: Provide the Agency with all final language versions (CAPs/EU procedures)
f.statement: For centrally authorised products and products subject to an EU procedure, the MAH should provide the Agency with a complete set of all final EU official language versions and any additional related communication documents.
f.clause: XV.C.2.2. Translation and dissemination of DHPCs
f.applicability: Centrally authorised products and products subject to an EU procedure

rows.quote: For centrally authorised medicinal products and medicinal products subject to an EU procedure, the relevant marketing authorisation holder should provide the Agency with a complete set of all final EU official language versions as well as any additional related communication documents.
rows.location: XV.C.2.2. Translation and dissemination of DHPCs
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Quote names MAH and should; statement faithful.
